summary.text: Julie Helmer is the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 40 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Karen DeSanto (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Helmer described herself as having 40 years of customer service experience and holding party leadership roles.

paragraphs.text: In the Ballotpedia survey, Helmer listed her background as 40 years of customer service, vice chair of the 2nd Congressional District Republican Party, secretary of the Sauk County Republican Party, a member of the Republican Party of Wisconsin executive committee, a 2024 presidential elector, and a Farm Bureau member.
She named healthcare and housing costs and consumer protection as policy areas she is passionate about.
She listed three key messages: protecting women's private spaces, changing how Wisconsin is governed, and children's education.
